storybox_source_of_truth.head: runtime/adaptation/storybox/storybox-head-v1.json
storybox_source_of_truth.rule: Storyteller consumes StoryBox state. It may select, compress, reorder within causal truth, and control reader knowledge, but may not rewrite StoryBox truth, outcomes, authority or information ownership.

demoted_material.note: These remain adaptation reservoirs. They may supply backstory only when current StoryBox state causally requires it.

round_game_rendering_rule.chapter_job: render the minimum reader-facing material needed to convey one or more meaningful StoryBox state transitions
round_game_rendering_rule.game_job: run one dominant decision/problem until resolution, failure, deadlock, equilibrium or supersession
round_game_rendering_rule.arc_job: carry persistent consequences across successor games
round_game_rendering_rule.world_job: preserve long-term people, relationships, reputation, institutions, map and memory

reader_first_rule: Every sentence, paragraph, scene and chapter must justify its existence to the reader. A sentence without action, new information, pressure, character revelation, power change, setup/payoff, necessary transition/orientation, or deliberate rhythm is presumed removable.
causal_density_rule: A scene must change state. A chapter must answer at least one prior question and deepen or create another. Each chapter pays off at least one prior setup before adding more than two major new setups.
payoff_rule: Every conspicuous object, anomaly, promise, name, discrepancy, secret or rule enters the payoff registry. Setups without later consequences are deleted.
character_entry_rule: A major actor enters prose only when StoryBox has already made them materially relevant through role, information, authority, interest, location or relationship. Ensemble coverage is never a reason to introduce a person.
technical_rule: Technical detail remains only when it changes a decision, responsibility, authority, workload, money, reputation, trust or later causal interpretation.
campbell_rule: Campbell remains hidden longitudinal structure for characters after they enter. It neither chooses StoryBox actions nor chapter order and never appears as explicit thesis dialogue.
nonnegotiable_rules: No adaptation hypothesis becomes ledger history.
StoryBox runs first; Storyteller renders second.
Storyteller may not rewrite fixed truth to improve drama.
Storyteller may hide information from reader but may not grant information to a character who does not possess it.
Write for a reader, not for a character dossier.
No paragraph exists solely for atmosphere, cleverness or authorial display.
No scene exists solely to prove a trait already established.
No chapter exists solely to introduce a character.
No single villain or single bug explains the central incident.
Every major faction protects something genuinely valuable and can still create external costs.
Do not let technical complexity replace human conflict.
Do not let human conflict require a faction to become stupid.
No roster balancing and no forced ensemble montage.
Do not use AI-summary endings, thesis dialogue or redundant meaning explanations.
A StoryBox deadlock is a valid outcome and must not be repaired by literary convenience.
2035 remains an observation endpoint for frozen history; adaptation games are explicitly noncanonical.

required_before_new_prose_chapter: execute StoryBox Round 3 from the missing manual-followup-status and rerun-authorization problem
activate hospital-side actor only because current StoryBox jurisdiction requires it
do not activate research, industry or public-sector core actors yet
evaluate Game 1 convergence after Round 3 using the explicit convergence policy
only then decide what subset of Round 3 deserves reader-facing prose
audit every rendered paragraph against sentence purpose and payoff debt
next_stage_gate.drafting_rule: Do not invent Chapter 3 first. Run Round 3 first, then render.
